dish: zantare — fried zangi chicken in house sweet-and-sour sauce (the original)
address: Tōya 1-39, Kushiro-chō, Kushiro District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The home of 'zantare': fresh-fried chicken thigh doused in a soy-sugar-vinegar sauce, in portions big enough that take-home boxes are standard; weekend queues.
